cases.title: POST - Should create post for existing user
cases.rationale: Creates a fresh user, posts to /users/{id}/posts and checks 201, the post schema, user_id and that title/body are echoed.

cases.title: POST - Should fail with 422 when title is missing
cases.rationale: Sends only a body for an existing user and expects a 422 error list containing field "title".
openQuestions: Should the test also pin the exact message ("can't be blank")? It is GoREST wording and may change.

cases.title: POST - Should fail with 422 when user does not exist
cases.rationale: Posts to /posts with user_id 999999999 and expects 422 with field "user" / "must exist". No data is created.

cases.title: POST - Should fail with 401 when unauthorized
cases.rationale: Same request without the bearer token; expects 401 and an "Authentication failed" message. Auth is checked before the user lookup, so no user is needed.

cases.title: GET - Should retrieve post by ID
cases.rationale: Creates a post, reads it back via /posts/{id} and compares the whole object plus schema.

cases.title: GET - Should return 404 for non-existent post
cases.rationale: GET /posts/999999999 must return 404 with a message, mirroring the existing user 404 test.

cases.title: GET - Should list only posts of the given user
cases.rationale: Creates two posts for a fresh user and expects exactly those two from /users/{id}/posts (fresh user = deterministic list).
openQuestions: Two POSTs per run on a rate-limited shared API — is one post enough for this requirement?

cases.title: POST - Should create post via /posts with user_id in body
cases.rationale: Covers the alternative endpoint from the requirement header (/posts with user_id in the body).
openQuestions: Is the /posts variant worth a separate test, or is TC-01 enough for POSTS-01?

coverageGaps.reason: Ordering of the global /posts list cannot be asserted deterministically on a shared public API with concurrent writers; recommend a contract test against a private GoREST instance.
